title: On Going to market every Thursday
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：go　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 go 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the director ① went to market every Thursday with great care, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② goes to market every Thursday on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ go to market every Thursday at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ gone to market every Thursday before — a line in the poster for August 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Going to market every Thursday with great care, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ go from house to house before dark on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Go from house to house before dark at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ goes from house to house before dark with great care every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ went to market every Thursday again when nobody else would.

⑩ To go to market every Thursday, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody goes to market every Thursday on the same day again and somebody must go to market every Thursday with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 去（一般过去式 went to market every Thursday：1986 年导演头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 去（一般现在 goes to market every Thursday：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 去（不定式 to go to market every Thursday：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 去（过去完成时 had gone to market every Thursday：1980 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 去（动名词 going to market every Thursday 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 走（go from house to house before dark：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去走天黑前一家家走过去）
G. v. 走（go from house to house before dark：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 去（后段两处：新来的演员照例 goes from house to house before dark，而母亲又一次 went to market every Thursday）

items.q: to go to market every Thursday
gone to market every Thursday before
go from house to house before dark on the same day
go from house to house before dark at once
goes from house to house before dark with great care
went to market every Thursday again
to go to market every Thursday

answers.why: go 意为“去”，1986 年导演小心翼翼地去每周四去赶集，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 went。
go 意为“去”，自那以后导演当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 goes。
go 意为“去”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯去每周四去赶集”，此处为不定式 to go to market every Thursday。
go 意为“去”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人去过，故用过去完成时 had gone。
go 意为“去”，导演说“去每周四去赶集这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 going to market every Thursday 作主语。
go 意为“走”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去走天黑前一家家走过去”，should ever 之后用原形 go from house to house before dark。
go 意为“走”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻走天黑前一家家走过去（go from house to house before dark at once），以后再也不要提起。
go 意为“去”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例走天黑前一家家走过去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 goes。
go 意为“去”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地去每周四去赶集，用一般过去式 went 叙述。
go 意为“去”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要去每周四去赶集，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，导演小心翼翼地去每周四去赶集；戏院里每一个演员都说这是头一回。（went to market every Thursday）
多年以后，导演仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（goes to market every Thursday）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯去每周四去赶集这件事本身。（to go to market every Thursday）
早在 1980 年就有人去每周四去赶集，八月那天戏报上的一行字就是证据。（had gone to market every Thursday）
导演说过，小心翼翼地去每周四去赶集这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（going to market every Thursday 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻走天黑前一家家走过去，以后再也不要提起。（go from house to house before dark，祈使句）
answers: In 1986 the director went to market every Thursday with great care, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the director still goes to market every Thursday on the same day without being asked.
My mother said later that to go to market every Thursday at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had gone to market every Thursday long before 1993, and the line in the poster for August proves it.
Going to market every Thursday with great care, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Go from house to house before dark at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 go 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the director went to market every Thursday with great care, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director goes to market every Thursday on the same day whenever the theatre asks.
Going to market every Thursday with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever go from house to house before dark on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre goes from house to house before dark with great care every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother went to market every Thursday again, and the theatre remembered that half.
